evals.prompt: Decompose the notification-service feature into work packages
evals.expected_output: Creates wp-01-api-scaffold/ and wp-02-delivery-adapters/ each with overview.md ONLY (status: spec), C1 eight-section shape, C2 frontmatter (owned_files, contract_slice, goal_approved_version: null, schema_version: 6), and a checklist of `- [ ] Tn <outcome> {files: a, b} [b1,b2]` lines. No per-item files, no todo.md. Updates the feature overview.md work packages table.
expectations: SKILL.md declares name: goalforge-decompose
SKILL.md reads plans/<feature>/spec.md as input
SKILL.md preconditions the feature overview.md is status: ready
SKILL.md writes only overview.md — no per-item files, no todo.md
SKILL.md WP overview.md is born status: spec, never another status
SKILL.md checklist item shape is `{files: a, b} [b1,b2]`, never a status/complexity/verify/depends_on/commit field
SKILL.md goal.outcome and goal.verification are always WP-authored, never inherited
Fixture spec.md has an Interface Contract section and a Work Packages table
Fixture overview.md has status: ready

evals.prompt: Break the payment-gateway feature down into work packages
evals.expected_output: Reads plans/payment-gateway/spec.md, creates wp-NN-* folders each with one overview.md (status: spec, C1/C2 shape), and updates the feature overview.md WP table.
expectations: SKILL.md triggers on user asking to decompose or break down work packages for a feature with an approved spec.md
SKILL.md derives depends_on from the spec WP table, backward-pointing only
SKILL.md self-check enforces facet coverage and one-owner/backward-deps invariants

evals.prompt: Approve the spec for the search-indexing-pipeline feature.
evals.expected_output: goalforge-decompose should NOT trigger — approving a spec is a goalforge-spec human-gate action, not a decompose action.
expectations: SKILL.md trigger requires an approved spec.md, not the approval step itself
A spec-approval request is outside the trigger surface of goalforge-decompose

evals.prompt: Decompose the notification-service spec; wp-01-api-scaffold/ already exists
evals.expected_output: Skips wp-01-api-scaffold entirely (folder-level idempotency). Creates wp-02-delivery-adapters/ normally if absent.
expectations: SKILL.md idempotency is folder-level: an existing WP folder is skipped without modification
SKILL.md does not clobber existing WP content

evals.prompt: Decompose the notification-service feature but spec.md does not exist
evals.expected_output: Skill fails: spec.md is a required precondition. Does not create any WP folders.
expectations: SKILL.md preconditions <PLANS_ROOT>/<feature>/spec.md exists with an ## Interface Contract
SKILL.md never creates WP folders without a valid spec.md input

evals.prompt: Append one new WP to the notification-service feature for a rate-limiter, without re-decomposing.
evals.expected_output: Add-WP mode: Steps 2-6 for the one new WP alone, numbered with the next free NN, touching no existing WP.
expectations: SKILL.md Add-WP mode documented with --add-wp <slug> --goal flags
SKILL.md Add-WP supports --derived-from and --source re-entry flags
SKILL.md routes a learning that changes or drops an existing WP to goalforge-redecompose instead
